To determine your macros using the IIFYM macro calculator, follow these steps:

1. Go to the IIFYM Macro Calculator website and scroll down.
2. Enter your details, including your age, height, weight, gender, activity level, and goal (e.g. losing weight, building muscle).
3. Select your preferred method of protein source (e.g. beef, chicken, fish) and enter your daily protein intake.
4. Select your preferred method of fat source (e.g. olive oil, coconut oil, nuts) and enter your daily fat intake.
5. Based on the information provided, the IIFYM macro calculator will calculate your recommended daily macronutrient intake.
6. Follow your calculated macronutrient intake to achieve your desired results.
7. Reevaluate your macronutrient intake periodically to ensure you are making progress towards your goals.

Note that the IIFYM macro calculator takes the guess work out of dieting by providing a customized recommendation based on your unique needs and preferences. If you want more control over your macronutrient intake, you can adjust the default settings in step 3 to your liking.
